addr: 7, Ground Floor, Nand Avenue, Next to Kailash Parbat and Nammur Joint, 8th Main Rd, Jayanagar 3rd Block East, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560011, India

rev.t: Amazing place to try ice cream and desserts. Different taste and varities of options to try. Bit costlier than others, still they give loyalty points to be redeemed in our next purchases. definitely a must try place if you are in jayanagar

Qoqo has a very good variety of sundaes & ice creams which has quite a good options of eggless stuffs too. All items are made inhouse.
The chocolate sauce & sundaes gives a tough competition to Corner house. …
I walked past this place countless times before finally stepping in yesterday and I’m so glad I did! The owners are incredibly warm and welcoming, which instantly makes you feel happy! …
